decision.observation: 5 mph, gear 1, timer 19:08.272, red X lit, all dots pale. The car is still centred on the gravel with its nose straight up-frame; the road continues straight then bends left near the top, boulders on the right, pines left.
decision.hypothesis: Speed has fallen 12 -> 10 -> 8 -> 5 mph across four plain-W seconds while staying centred, consistent with a steep uphill grade rather than a pin. If the grade eases, speed should rise again; if it keeps falling to 0 the car has stalled.
decision.memory: Long uphill straights can bleed speed to ~5 mph under full throttle even with the car perfectly aligned, so don't mistake it for a pin and don't steer to 'fix' it.
